# Dynamic loading

The mode flags `dlopen` takes.

<h2 id="rtld-lazy"><code>RTLD_LAZY</code></h2>

```rux
pub const RTLD_LAZY: int32 = 1;
```

`RTLD_LAZY`: resolve a function symbol the first time it is called rather than at load.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Linux/Src/Dynamic.rux#L15)

<h2 id="rtld-now"><code>RTLD_NOW</code></h2>

```rux
pub const RTLD_NOW: int32 = 2;
```

`RTLD_NOW`: resolve every symbol before `dlopen` returns, so a missing one is reported there.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Linux/Src/Dynamic.rux#L20)

<h2 id="rtld-global"><code>RTLD_GLOBAL</code></h2>

```rux
pub const RTLD_GLOBAL: int32 = 256;
```

`RTLD_GLOBAL`: make this object's symbols available to objects loaded afterwards.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Linux/Src/Dynamic.rux#L25)

<h2 id="rtld-local"><code>RTLD_LOCAL</code></h2>

```rux
pub const RTLD_LOCAL: int32 = 0;
```

`RTLD_LOCAL`: keep this object's symbols to itself, which is the default.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Linux/Src/Dynamic.rux#L30)

<h2 id="rtld-nodelete"><code>RTLD_NODELETE</code></h2>

```rux
pub const RTLD_NODELETE: int32 = 4096;
```

`RTLD_NODELETE`: do not unload the object when its last reference goes, so its storage stays valid.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Linux/Src/Dynamic.rux#L35)
